== About Me ==
Hi I'm Austin, I'm a member of the Kernel Team at Canonical.

== What I do ==
I joined the Kernel Team at Canonical on April 7th, 2025. I work on the TNT squad, helping out with kernel regression tests, regression testing infrastructure, as well as other TNT projects like Cloudprov and KTDB.
